q2: SELECT DISTINCT VIEWER_ID ID FROM VIEWS WHERE AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID ORDER BY ID ASC

counterexample: INSERT INTO VIEWS (ARTICLE_ID, AUTHOR_ID, VIEWER_ID, VIEW_DATE) VALUES (1, 101, 102, '2023-01-01'); INSERT INTO VIEWS (ARTICLE_ID, AUTHOR_ID, VIEWER_ID, VIEW_DATE) VALUES (2, 102, 101, '2023-01-02');
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because they select different columns (AUTHOR_ID vs VIEWER_ID) for the DISTINCT operation. Although both queries order the results by ID, the actual IDs being ordered are different.
